title: HypoLoop: Revising Weight-Editing Plans from Scientific Feedback
read_level: full (arXiv HTML: main text, Table 1 skimmed, Appendix A.2/A.3/B; Appendix C/D proofs skimmed only)
why_wsp: LLMs (DeepSeek, Claude) propose and revise editing plans (which native coordinates to edit and the fitting rule/weighting) from prediction errors and validation history; numerical solvers (linearized fit or Adam) compute the weight patches, so the LLM does not write weight values.
domain: scientific prediction models across 22 tasks (PDE surrogates, depth estimation, chemistry, materials, seismic, remote sensing, industrial inspection)
editor: deepseek-flash (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017) and claude-fable-5 as plan proposers; numerical solvers compute patches
target: task-specific pretrained predictors (e.g. GEARS, Uni-Mol, FNO-type, depth and change-detection nets); parameter counts not summarized
interface: other (LLM proposes coordinate sets and executable weighting/loss configs; solver computes patch, partly gradient-based via Adam)
loop: closed-loop with feedback (sequential rounds, two proposal stages per round, internal CV acceptance)
fraction_or_count_of_weights_changed: 'The final DeepSeek Burgers edit selects 7,617 coordinates and changes 7,299 values.' (Sec 4.3); DIODE uses 'the same 33 editable coordinates' (Abstract); SpaceNet7 'first patch changes 7,554 values' (Sec 4.6)

headline_results.claim: Dynamic relocation on Burgers at matched budget
headline_results.quote: Feedback-guided relocation reduces Burgers error by 58.80% and 47.72% while keeping the editable-coordinate budget fixed.

headline_results.claim: Positive-residual weighting on DIODE at fixed 33 coordinates
headline_results.quote: Positive-residual weighting reduces DIODE internal CV AbsRel by 13.35% at the same 33-coordinate editable set.

headline_results.claim: LLM plan revision vs fixed initial plan
headline_results.quote: Revision reduces DIODE AbsRel from 0.418085 to 0.373803 under Claude ( 10.59% ), phonon-peak MAE from 59.452 to 56.117 cm -1 under DeepSeek ( 5.61% )

headline_results.claim: DIODE depth with HL-Global vs base
headline_results.quote: On DIODE, HL-Global lowers image AbsRel from 0.4070 for Base to 0.2425 ( 40.41% ).
Full-split F1 rises from 0.2507 for Adam to 0.2899 (+3.93 points)

headline_results.claim: Mixed results across 22 tasks: some HypoLoop variants negative vs strongest control (e.g. ESOL HL-Auto -18.0/-21.9)
headline_results.quote: Positive values indicate relative error reductions (%) or AP/F1 gains in percentage points (pp).

baselines_and_controls: Base (unchanged), Adam on fixed local subset, Memory (distance-weighted residual correction), Calib (output scale/bias); within-family ablations HL-Fixed (keep first LLM plan), HL-Once, fixed vs dynamic locations at matched budget, reversed residual weighting.
runs_and_variance: Paired 95% intervals reported for matched location comparisons (Fig 3); number of runs/seeds per task not stated; single trajectory per service appears to be reported.
robustness_of_edits: not tested beyond sequential held-out feedback batches
verification: none formal; internal cross-validation acceptance thresholds
cites_or_builds_on: Takehi et al. Sparks of WSP
notes_for_survey: LLM-as-planner variant of closed-loop WSP: the LLM chooses edit locations and fitting objectives while numerical (including gradient-based) solvers write the weights. Same group as WeightLoop; reports per-task results for two LLM services across 22 scientific tasks with mixed signs in Table 1.
